Generated Narrative: CodeSystem speiro-consent-metadata-gap

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.speirotech.net/CodeSystem/speiro-consent-metadata-gap defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
evaluated-at-unavailable Evaluation time unavailableThe actual evaluation time for this contribution is unavailable in its selected immutable supporting facts. Does not mean permission is unknown or that evaluation did not occur. Start, binding-write and assembly times are not substitutes.
issued-unavailable Observation availability time unavailableThe actual time this Observation version became available to providers is unavailable. Does not assert that it was never available. Start, evaluation, binding-write and report assembly times are not substitutes.
assembly-actor-unavailable Assembly actor unavailableThe actual agent responsible for assembling this contribution cannot be supported from the selected immutable facts. Does not identify the consent decision maker or assert that no agent acted.
assembly-recorded-at-unavailable Assembly recording time unavailableThe actual time the assembly Provenance was recorded is unavailable. Does not mean the assembly event did not occur. Observation availability and assembly occurrence times are not substitutes.
assembly-input-associations-incomplete Assembly input associations incompleteOne or more required associations between this contribution and its actual immutable assembly input versions cannot be established completely. May include lost associations; does not assert that underlying consent evidence is absent or invent an input identity or count.

name: SpeiroConsentMetadataGap
title: Speiro Consent Metadata Gap
description: A specific unavailable metadata fact or incomplete assembly-input association for a selected consent contribution. Does not establish consent absence, withdrawal, permission, capture blocking, report outcome, treatment/payment consequences or an operational hold.
